units.source_text: 行平姓在原，中纳言是其官名。

en.t: Yukihira's family name was Ariwara, and Chunagon was the title of his office.

units.source_text: 其诗云：“若有人寻我，请君代答云：离居须磨浦，寂寞度残生。”

en.t: His poem says, "If someone comes looking for me, please answer in my place: I live apart on the shore of Suma, spending the rest of my life in loneliness."
This appears in the Kokin Wakashu.
